messages.author: 81de21f613ba8a94
messages.subject: Errorbar points-filling and outlines
parts:
Hello,
For esthetic reasons, I would like to fill the white  circular and triangular errorbar points of the following example white, so that the black errorbar lines within the white circular/ triangular points are not visible anymore.
is that possible? Furthermore, I would like slightly thicker outlines of the white circular/ triangular errorbar points.

Thank you very much for your help,
Mike

Example code:

Gruppe <- paste("G", 1:10, sep="")
Klasse <- paste("K", 1:3,  sep="")
Wert.Gruppe <- rnorm(10,(11:20)^2,2)*runif(10, min=0.7, max=1.3)
names(Wert.Gruppe) <- Gruppe
Wert.Klasse <- runif(5,min=0.5,max=1)
names(Wert.Klasse) <- Klasse
DF <- expand.grid(Gruppe=Gruppe, Klasse=Klasse)
DF$Mitte <- Wert.Gruppe[DF$Gruppe]*Wert.Klasse[DF$Klasse]
DF$hi <- DF$Mitte + 2*sqrt(DF$Mitte)
DF$lo <- DF$Mitte - 2*sqrt(DF$Mitte)
library(ggplot2)
Grafik <- ggplot(DF, aes(x=Gruppe, y=Mitte, colour=Klasse)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=lo, ymax=hi, linetype=Klasse,shape=Klasse), size=1.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_point(size=2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values=c(1,1,1))+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","black","black"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 2,19))+
  theme_bw()
Grafik
